text:
carla: Heads-up — we need a final lockfile bump + vendor sync before the release cutoff tomorrow 09:00 PT. Asking who can own submodule PRs and the vendor bump.
ben: I can take the 3rdparty/onnx submodule. Will open the PR and tag reviewers in ~30m.
alice: Taking the vendor libs bump (protobuf -> 3.20.1, grpc -> 1.57). I'll run the smoke tests and include a build matrix change.
jamie: Reminder: protobuf bump is technically a minor but it changes generated APIs. Please add a changelog note and call out migration steps.
mayank: Quick check — are we syncing the vendor tree into release/v1.2.0 or doing the bump on main and backporting? I prefer bump on release branch to avoid CI churn on main.
olivia: I'm happy to do the backport if you bump on main. Also can do the lockfile merge conflicts after everyone's PRs land.
carla: Good point. Let's do the bump directly on release/v1.2.0 to keep main stable. ben/alice — please target that branch.
ben: ack, will branch from release/v1.2.0 and include the submodule sha + brief rationale in the PR body.
alice: PR draft incoming in ~45m to release/v1.2.0. Will run `./scripts/vendor-sync.sh` then `git add vendor && git commit -m "vendor: bump protobuf grpc"`.
jamie: Changelog: add entry under "Dependencies" with note: "protobuf 3.20.1 — regenerate protos; minor API shape changes". I can review the wording.
release-bot: auto-note: Release cutoff scheduled for 2026-03-18 09:00 PT (18 hours from now). Please ensure all dependency PRs are merged and lockfiles updated by cutoff.
mayank: Small gotcha — some internal services pin old proto; will open a compatibility PR to update generated code in infra repo after vendor bump.
olivia: After PRs merge, I'll run `tools/lockfile/merge-locks --branch release/v1.2.0` and post the resulting lockfile changes here for a quick sanity check.
carla: Assignments: ben -> onnx submodule; alice -> vendor libs bump; olivia -> lockfile merge + conflict resolution; mayank -> infra compatibility patch; jamie -> changelog + final review. If anyone hits blockers, ping me @carla and I'll reassign.
ben: noted. tagging @alice @olivia when PRs are up.
alice: PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/11234> — targets release/v1.2.0. CI queued.
jamie: I'll look at changelog and the PR in a bit.
olivia: I'll wait for CI artifacts then run the lockfile merge. Expect a follow-up here with the merged lockfile diff.
carla: Thanks all — trying to keep this tight so releases team can do the final smoke tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
ben: one more note — if the vendor bump increases binary size we might need a bake window on Dedicated. I'll include size numbers in the PR.
alice: saw flaky test on CI, rerunning. If it persists, will hotfix on the branch and ping infra.
mayank: +1 on the compatibility patch; will link once created.
olivia: Merged lockfile preview:
```
- protobuf==3.19.4
+ protobuf==3.20.1
- grpc==1.56.0
+ grpc==1.57.0
```
olivia: No semver-major API changes observed in generated code diff; just parameter reorder in a util helper.
release-bot: deploy-check: all dependency PRs must include changelog entry and have passing CI by cutoff.
carla: Closing loop — everything assigned and PRs in flight. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases if any merge conflicts block the lockfile. Thanks everyone.
